description: Each existing transcript entry (AssistantHeader/Status, AssistantMessage text/thinking blocks, BashExecution, ToolExecution, Diff, UserMessage, CompactionSummary) becomes a VHole with the entry struct as props. The do_weld/3 + weld_lines/3 walk is deleted; assistant turns are emitted as %VZone{open, close, final, child} (or plain VFlow when has_tool_calls?). Existing transcript_test.exs assertions stay green; OSC 133 byte sequences land in the same positions per pixel-diff.
title: Migrate Transcript: entries become VHole/VLines; replace OSC welder with VZone
